newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Wawel shareholders against rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Polish Wawel shareholders against rights issue.

text.p: Polish confectioner Zaklady Cukiernicze Wawel SA, planning to go public this year, will not issue rights shares, its shareholders' meeting decided on Saturday.
"Only 61 percent of shareholders voted in favour of the rights issue while the required majority was 75 percent," Wawel president Wladyslaw Kaczmarczyk told reporters.

He said the shareholders' meeting had confirmed plans to issue between 600,000 and one million new shares. The issue prospectus is likely to be sent to the Securities Commission by the end of June this year, he added. @
Wawel, located in the southern town of Krakow, had a net profit of 9.5 million zlotys in 1995 on sales of 160 million zlotys.
The company has a share capital of 1,037,100 million zlotys divided into 10,371 shares with a nominal value of 100 zlotys each. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
